item.description:
AgentsEye 0.17.15 introduces private, local Prompt Intelligence.
- Prompt capture is off by default and requires explicit opt-in. - Supported user-authored prompts are redacted for common secrets, encrypted on this Mac, and never sent to AgentsEye. - Search prompt text, projects, models, and providers, then open a complete prompt chain for a session. - Connect each prompt to its observed model, effort, token usage, API-equivalent value, and usage session. - Find related wording across sessions with deterministic on-device similarity. No AI provider or quota is used. - Choose 7, 30, or 90-day retention, disable individual providers, or delete the local prompt index at any time. - Provider responses, diagnostics, reports, alerts, Discord messages, and telemetry never include prompt text. - Recent transcript indexing is bounded and incremental-friendly; a fixed OpenCode pipe deadlock no longer leaves AgentsEye reading forever. - Background provider refresh remains non-interactive. Declining Keychain access does not block the app or require repeated password dialogs.

AgentsEye 0.17.14 fixes dashboard window duplication and improves Claude recovery safety.
- Repeatedly choosing Open Dashboard now focuses one dashboard instead of creating new windows. - Claude recovery never scans Chromium Safe Storage entries in the background. - Existing Firefox-family session fallback remains available without broad browser probing. - Claude Code OAuth remains the preferred usage source when available. - A valid Claude Code CLI sign-in is now recognized even when Anthropic does not expose live quota to AgentsEye.

AgentsEye 0.17.13 makes Claude reconnection clear and browser-neutral.
- Removes browser-brand implementation details from the Claude reconnect flow. - Opens Claude's own usage page in the user's default browser. - Explains the connection in terms of Claude Code and claude.ai instead of a specific browser. - Keeps the local browser-session fallback and privacy protections introduced in 0.17.12.
